availability.dataset: The official README exposes Box links for dataset 1.0 train, validation, test, and map archives plus a Google Drive sample.

repositoryAudit.finding: The fixed repository contains the README, two framework images, map utilities, and a small set of generic OpenCOOD utilities, but no V2XPnP model, trainer, evaluator, experiment configuration, or checkpoint.
opencood/data_utils/datasets/__init__.py imports five dataset modules that are absent from the fixed repository tree.

The README calls V2XPnP an open-source framework and lists an eleven-model benchmark zoo, while its release plan schedules official codebase version 1.0 for 2025-12 and the audited 2026-07-31 repository still lacks that code.

maintainerEvidence.finding: The repository owner stated that the full codebase was still being organized and finalized.
The repository owner said the delayed code would be released within that month.
A later code-release request remains open without a maintainer response.

candidateImpact.reason: The proposed equivalence audit needs a faithful one-step spatiotemporal implementation, a causal-arrival comparator, fixed configurations, and reproducible predictions. None is available from the fixed official release. The public dataset alone cannot establish equivalence to the unpublished implementation.

allowedUse: Use the paper and released dataset as evidence that one-step history communication is a scientifically relevant contract to test.
Audit the released dataset and map utilities as separate data assets after archive hashes and manifests are frozen.
Reconsider the candidate if an official commit-bound implementation and checkpoints become available.
forbiddenUse: Do not describe the official V2XPnP method implementation or model zoo as publicly available.
Do not substitute a newly invented implementation and attribute its behavior to V2XPnP.
Do not claim one-step and causal-arrival equivalence or inequivalence from the paper description alone.
Do not treat issue closure in 2025 as evidence that the promised code was released.
recheckTriggers: The official repository publishes model, training, and evaluation code at a fixed commit.
Official checkpoints and configurations become available with stable hashes.
A maintainer supplies an archived implementation that can be independently reproduced.
